item.title: Vitalik Buterin Selling Ethereum 'Faster,' Says On-Chain Tracking Firm As Second-Largest Crypto Plunges Over 5%
item.description: Vitalik Buterin offloaded millions worth of Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) over the past couple of days, coinciding with a significant drop in the cryptocurrency’s price. ETH Exits Buterin’s Wallet In an X post on Sunday evening, on-chain tracker Lookonchain pointed to the sale of 1,869 ETH, worth $3.67 million, over the last 48 hours. This sale coincided with a 5.7% drop in ETH’s price, sliding from the high $1,900s into the mid-$1,800s. “Vitalik Buterin is selling ETH faster again,” added Lookonchain.
